elysiumnpcs.amnesty.at_floor: Nothing here can be discharged. Suspicion is already at the structural floor of %s — the Empire will not forget a fortress.
elysiumnpcs.amnesty.granted: The file is amended. %s discharged; %s outstanding.
elysiumnpcs.amnesty.nothing_filed: There is nothing on file to amend.
elysiumnpcs.amnesty.tooltip_floor: Never below the structural floor of what you have claimed.
elysiumnpcs.commission.expired: The commission lapsed. The Court has noted it.
elysiumnpcs.commission.not_my_office: This office does not commission work. Take it to the throne.
elysiumnpcs.commission.nothing_wanted: The Court wants for nothing it can name.
elysiumnpcs.commission.settled: The commission is discharged. %s rewards are entered against your name.
elysiumnpcs.nothing_to_give: They search their office and find nothing to give you.
elysiumnpcs.refusal.architect: You have not been drawn on any plan of mine.
elysiumnpcs.refusal.commander: The fleet takes recommendations. You have none.
elysiumnpcs.refusal.emperor: The Code has no filing for you yet.
elysiumnpcs.refusal.queen: I have not yet had cause to look at you.
elysiumnpcs.title.emperor: Emperor of the Black and Emerald
elysiumnpcs.title.queen: Queen of the Empire, Former Sentient Star
elysiumnpcs.tooltip.gear_bench: Deals in parts, and in the plans for them.
elysiumnpcs.tooltip.hydroponics_rack: Food without soil, which is what a station eats.
elysiumnpcs.tooltip.salvage_rig: Takes the broken things nobody else wants.
elysiumnpcs.tooltip.signal_mast: Reads the sky and sells what it hears.
elysiumnpcs.tooltip.splicing_vat: Grows things that did not use to grow.
elysiumnpcs.tooltip.void_crucible: Melts what you bring and gives it back better.
